paper_title: WebGLM Towards An Efficient Web-Enhanced Question Answering System with   Human Preferences
caption: retriever time analysis.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average, 50th percentile, 75th percentile, and 90th percentile retrieval times (in seconds) for four different operations: Search, Extract, Fetch, and Retrieval. The horizontal axis represents the percentiles of retrieval time, ranging from “Avg.” to “90%,” with evenly spaced tick marks. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. sec,” displays the retrieval times, starting at 0.0 and extending to a maximum value of 8.0, utilizing a linear scale with tick marks incremented by 2.0. The bar corresponding to “Search” is represented by a dark blue color and has an approximate height of 8.0 seconds. The “Extract” bar is light blue and has a height of 6.0 seconds. The “Fetch” bar is a medium blue color and has a height of 4.0 seconds, while the “Retrieval” bar is a light blue color and is approximately 4.0 seconds tall.  All bars are presented in ascending order of height and are not visually emphasized or shaded.
